 More than $1.2 million in 2025 tax refunds were paid for income tax returns filed through Sept. 30, according to the Department of Revenue and Taxation and the Department of Administration.
 Here are the highlights from the latest payment batch:
 • Total refund amount: $1,257,503.16
 • Total payments processed: 54,072
 • Paper checks: 39,242
 • Electronic fund transfers: 14,380
 This latest installment brings the total amount paid to $154,924,110.17 for the year to date.
 DRT continues to process 2025 income tax returns in the order they were filed. Residents who owe taxes and cannot pay the full amount may contact DRT's Collection Branch to discuss payment options.
 Due to the surge in the volume of returns, turnaround time will continue to fluctuate between eight and ten weeks.
 For more information or assistance, taxpayers can contact DRT’s Call Center at (671) 635-1840/1841/7651 or email pinadmin@revtax.guam.gov .
